license.name: M&Ms Dataset Research Use Agreement
license.non_academic_use: requires case-by-case approval from the M&Ms organizers

key_clauses.5_no_distribution: YOU MAY NOT DISTRIBUTE, PUBLISH, OR REPRODUCE A COPY of any portion or all of the M&Ms Dataset to others without specific prior written permission from M&Ms organizers.
key_clauses.6_no_derivatives_except_clause_2: You must not modify, reverse engineer, decompile, or create derivative works from the M&Ms Dataset with the exception of works in agreement with the clause number 2.
key_clauses.2_models_and_code_encouraged: any computational model or algorithm that have used the M&Ms Dataset and is publicly referenced (e.g. in a publication etc..) is suggested to be shared including the code and model weights and must give appropriate credit by citing the M&Ms article but not in any way that suggests that the M&Ms organizers endorses you or your use.
key_clauses.7_research_use_only: Not for diagnosis or provision of patient care.
key_clauses.9_no_reidentification: Re-identification is strictly prohibited and must be reported.
key_clauses.10_termination: Violation may require returning all copies and retaining none.

consequences_for_this_project: Clause 6 forbids derivative works of the data, and clause 2's exception covers models and algorithms rather than datasets. Fitted meshes or a derived benchmark built from M&Ms-2 are therefore data derivatives and cannot be released, matching the position already forced by MVSeg2023.

Clause 2 is more permissive than assumed for the software side: sharing code and model weights is explicitly suggested, not merely tolerated, so releasing the method and any trained weights is encouraged provided the M&Ms article is cited and no endorsement is implied.
Clause 1 restricts use to research and requires approval for non-academic use; this project is academic, so the default permission applies.
Clause 7 rules out any diagnostic or patient-care framing of results, which aligns with the claim boundaries already in force.
